title: Reel
intro: Product launch films, explainers, ads, and brand motion work pulled from case studies across this site — all in one place.

videos.title: Introducing Marlin AI

videos.title: Secure By Design
videos.description: A product UI and risk-illustration motion piece — a support chat widget alongside an animated illustration of unsecured work at a laptop, flagged with warning icons.

videos.title: Comply AI for Remediation
videos.description: A product explainer demonstrating Comply AI: detecting a misconfigured AWS resource and generating a Terraform fix automatically, no manual work required.

videos.title: SOC 2 Trust Service Criteria
